rules: The sheet is the confirmation: production's dialog is cut.
Triage's hospital set is drained here; the mark's execution needs no screen of its own.

elements.name: Pen list
elements.shows: Units and pens as labels, not navigation
elements.logic: The current unit is pinned first and the source cell dimmed ("where they are now"); cross-unit groups wear their full path; search results are flat with the path trailing.

states.shows: Dashed (for a hospital drain it is the answer)

elements.rule: Tap commits: the sheet closes and the drawer's Picker is filled.

notes.purpose: Three tagged pigs and nine head: both conditionals under one commit.

elements.name: Group verdicts
elements.shows: Each open group record on the source pen

states.shows: Record stays on the source pen

states.when: Chosen, or when the whole population leaves (n = N)
states.shows: Record moves; the checklist folds to a footnote

elements.name: Which batches the head leave
elements.logic: Appears for a multi-batch group only; the steppers must sum to n (4 + 5 = 9). Single-batch groups ride silently. No block prints for an all-tagged selection.

screens.name: After · the cards are the receipt

notes.purpose: The pen cards after the move.
rules: Counts re-derive from placements for tagged pigs and are set by count for head (one-number law).
A case arrived with the pig; head arrive under their own batches as a group row with a count trail.

screens.name: Transfer sow · from a sow record

notes.purpose: Moving one sow from her Farrowing record: Actions, then Transfer sow.

elements.name: Transfer sow button
elements.shows: Destination unit and destination pen, with the origin shown above
elements.rule: Disabled until a unit and a pen are chosen and the destination differs from her current pen. The pen field stays disabled until a unit is chosen, and the current pen is left out of the list in her own unit. Saving moves her, writes "Transferred · origin to destination" to her log and returns to her record.

rules: Not offered for a sow that has died.
issues: Two unit and pen select fields, not the destination picker of the Transfer deck (current unit pinned, search, scan); the two designs differ.
